text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky and I go shopping together one day…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hmm… These green onions look wonderful.

text_block_list.text: Excuse me! Could I have some of these along with the cabbage?

text_block_list.text: You certainly have a good eye for produce! Take a raffle ticket too, as a gift!

text_block_list.text: A gift? You're giving them out to everyone, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Vegetable Seller
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! You caught me!

text_block_list.text: But let's enjoy our day a bit longer! You see, that old lady told me something interesting…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Step right up and try your luck with our New Year's raffle! This year's grand-prize is a hot spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot hamburger steak! Second-prize winners get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize winners can take home a single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Don't let this opportunity pass you by! Get a ticket now and spin for your chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ta-da! Shall we try it together?

text_block_list.text: That's right! I got a ticket from the lady at the grocery store! We can't not use it, right?

text_block_list.text: Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a grand-prize winner! Come and get the coupon for your hot spring vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.text: I feel guilty receiving something like this just for going shopping with Maruzensky. And besides, she's the one who won it.
